summary: Master real estate cybersecurity. Prevent wire fraud, secure MLS data, and implement NIST CSF. Expert-led training for brokers, REITs, and property managers.
lede: Cybersecurity for real estate professionals focuses on protecting property data, client information, and digital transactions. Designed for brokers, property managers, escrow and title staff, and others handling sensitive data or high-value transactions, it covers cyber risk assessment, CRM and account security, and safer wire-transfer procedures. Participants also learn to prepare an incident response plan for property data breaches.
audienceIntro: This intermediate-level course is essential for professionals who handle sensitive property data and high-value financial transactions in an increasingly digital environment.
audience: Compliance Officers in real estate firms
modules: AI and Automation in Real Estate Security
prerequisites: Participants should have a minimum of 2-3 years of experience in real estate operations, property management, or title services. A basic understanding of digital tools (CRM, MLS, digital signatures) is required. No prior technical cybersecurity experience is necessary, but familiarity with standard office IT environments is expected.
